text:
jess (eng-platform): quick sync — we want to make the /api/v1/generate endpoint require an explicit model-selection header (X-Model-Id) instead of silently falling back to a tenant default. goal: avoid unexpected default flips when we change catalog defaults. proposing canary + 2-week grace window for clients that don't set the header. thoughts? :thinking_face:

omar (eng): +1 on preventing surprises. main concern: a lot of mobile SDK users don't set headers today. how strict is the canary? 400 immediately, or soft-warning first?

jess (eng-platform): thinking soft-first: during canary we return 200 but include a deprecation-warning header and a new response field "warning": "missing-model-header" for telemetry. after grace window -> 400. canary would be ~5% of traffic for 3 days.

omar (eng): OK. mobile: we should ship an SDK patch that auto-sets X-Model-Id from config before we flip to 400. pinging maya for SDK work.

maya (devex): can do. I'll prepare patches for js/python/android and include a lightweight shim: if header missing, set it to tenant-default (with a telem event). estimate: 48 hours for JS+Python, 72 for mobile.

riley (eng-sre): need infra/observability checklist before canary. we should track: 1) rate of "missing-model-header" warnings, 2) 4xx spike, 3) downstream latency. I'll add tracing tags: model_selection=explicit|fallback and total_tokens. also need capacity bump on canary hosts in case of cascade.

sam (product): comms: docs + console banner + in-app email for top 50 orgs. can we include a tenant mapping in console so orgs can set a global model that SDKs will pick up automatically? that reduces churn.

jess (eng-platform): yes, console mapping is already on the roadmap — can we fast-track a minimal toggle that serves tenant-default to SDKs? may be quick.

sam (product): i'll prioritize it for next sprint and draft an email template.

maya (devex): quick code example for the SDK shim I'm planning: 
```
// pseudocode
if (!headers['X-Model-Id']) {
  analytics.capture('missing-model-header', { tenant_id });
  headers['X-Model-Id'] = tenantConfig.model_default || 'redwood-small-v1';
}
```

riley (eng-sre): +1 on telemetry. also add a Prometheus alert: rate(missing_model_header[5m]) > 0.05 * request_rate -> pager, so we evaluate client impact early.

omar (eng): what about server-side fallback for private deployments (VPC/on-prem)? some customers expect strictness only for hosted.

jess (eng-platform): good point. plan: flag is tenant-scoped — hosted tenants default to enforcement timeline; private tenants get opt-in unless they request enforcement. we'll document a per-tenant policy.

maya (devex): will update SDK README and changelog. also add migration snippet for apps that used default behavior.

sam (product): communications plan: (1) console banner + migration guide, (2) email to active org owners with steps + sample SDK patch, (3) blog post about why explicit model selection matters. proposed timeline: canary next Tue (3 days), grace window 14 days, enforcement -> 400 after that.

jess (eng-platform): timeline acked. action items:
- maya: SDK patches + sample code (due in 48–72h)
- riley: instrumentation + alerting + canary hosts config (due EOD today)
- sam: comms copy + org list (due tomorrow)
- omar/jess: rollout script + CLI to change tenant flag (due before canary)

deploy-bot: deploys/ci: canary playbook branch built: ci/require-model-header-canary #1257 succeeded :white_check_mark:

omar (eng): I'll prep the rollout script. one more ask: add an opt-out header (X-Allow-Implicit-Model: true) that we honor only during the grace window, so partners can test without immediate failure. remove it on enforcement.

jess (eng-platform): fine as temporary escape hatch for partner testing, only enabled for specified tenants. good idea.

riley (eng-sre): logging note: mark any request with X-Allow-Implicit-Model in logs so we can filter partners.

maya (devex): will include migration notes + the opt-out header in SDK docs.

sam (product): thanks all. i'll schedule a quick async update doc in product/announcements and post links in #general when ready. :rocket:
